info.title: jira (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Jira Cloud REST API v3. Authorization: Bearer {api_token} or Basic base64(email:token). Issue keys look like 'PROJ-123'. Project keys are short uppercase identifiers like 'PROJ'.

get.summary: Query Jira projects by name or key. Returns the project key required when creating new issues.
get.description: Query Jira projects by name or key. Returns the project key required when creating new issues.

parameters.name: query

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).
